description: Self-Healing Scraper & DOM-to-JSON Compiler — Synthesizes durable CSS selectors (Cheerio; no XPath) for a target JSON schema, proves them against the live DOM in-request, and returns the extracted data plus a ready-to-run TypeScript Cheerio extractor.

html.description: Raw HTML to use instead of fetching.

previousBrokenSelectors.description: Map of field name to the CSS selector that stopped working.

targetSchema.description: JSON Schema of the fields to extract: an object whose properties are string/number/integer/boolean (or arrays of those), or an array whose items are such an object for list pages. The pattern keyword is not allowed.

url.description: Page to fetch. Provide url or html.

name: heal-scraper
